controls.title: Ensure third party integrated applications are not allowed
controls.description: Users must not be able to register or consent to third-party applications on their own.
controls.rationale: Illicit consent grants are a standard persistence technique: the attacker never needs the user's password again.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will need to request administrator approval before an application can access their data.

assertions.failure: Standard users can register third-party applications (allowedToCreateApps is {actual}).
assertions.hint: PATCH the authorization policy so defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateApps is false.

controls.title: Ensure user consent to apps accessing company data on their behalf is not allowed
controls.description: User consent must be restricted to applications from verified publishers requesting low-impact permissions, or blocked entirely.
controls.rationale: This is the single control that stops an OAuth phishing campaign from succeeding tenant-wide.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will need administrator approval for new applications.
controls.remediationProcedure: PATCH the authorization policy so permissionGrantPolicyIdsAssignedToDefaultUserRole is empty, or contains only the low-impact verified-publisher policy.

audit.name: Read the user consent permission grant policy

assertions.failure: Users can consent to any application on their own behalf ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Remove the legacy self-consent grant policy so consent is restricted to verified publishers or blocked.

remediation.name: Restrict user consent to verified publishers

controls.title: Ensure that guest user access is restricted
controls.description: Guests must hold the most restrictive directory role, unable to enumerate other objects.
controls.rationale: A default guest can read the directory, which hands an attacker a full org chart and target list.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Guests will no longer be able to browse the directory or see other guests.
controls.remediationProcedure: PATCH the authorization policy setting guestUserRoleId to 2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b.

audit.name: Read the guest user role assignment

assertions.failure: Guests hold role {actual}; CIS requires the restricted guest role {expected}.
assertions.hint: Set guestUserRoleId to 2af84b1e-32c8-42b7-82bc-daa82404023b so guests cannot read directory objects.

controls.title: Ensure guest user invitations are limited to the Guest Inviter role
controls.description: Only members of the Guest Inviter role may invite external users.
controls.rationale: Uncontrolled invitation lets any user extend tenant access to an outsider without review.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Standard users will no longer be able to invite guests.
controls.remediationProcedure: PATCH the authorization policy setting allowInvitesFrom to adminsAndGuestInviters.

assertions.failure: Guest invitations are allowed from {actual}; CIS requires {expected}.
assertions.hint: Set allowInvitesFrom to adminsAndGuestInviters on the authorization policy.

remediation.name: Limit invitations to the Guest Inviter role

controls.title: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users in administrative roles
controls.description: A Conditional Access policy must require MFA for every privileged directory role.
controls.rationale: Administrative credentials without MFA are the highest-value target in the tenant.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Administrators will be prompted for MFA at sign-in.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AA-03 Users and devices are authenticated
controls.auditProcedure:
GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies
Confirm an enabled policy targets the privileged directory roles and grants control mfa.
controls.remediationProcedure: Create a Conditional Access policy named 'CA001 - Require MFA for admins' targeting the privileged directory roles with the Require multifactor authentication grant, and set its state to enabled.

audit.name: Look for an enabled admin MFA policy

assertions.failure: No enabled Conditional Access policy requires MFA for administrative roles ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Create and enable a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA for all privileged directory roles.

remediation.name: Deploy the admin MFA Conditional Access policy
remediation.payload: { "method": "PATCH", "path": "/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies", "emulatorKey": "graph:conditionalAccessPolicies", "body": { "value": [ { "displayName": "CA001 - Require MFA for admins", "state": "enabled", "adminMfa": true, "blockLegacyAuth": false }, { "displayName": "CA002 - Block legacy authentication", "state": "disabled", "adminMfa": false, "blockLegacyAuth": false } ] } }

rollback.name: Remove the admin MFA policy
rollback.payload: { "method": "PATCH", "path": "/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies", "emulatorKey": "graph:conditionalAccessPolicies", "body": { "value": [ { "displayName": "CA001 - Require MFA for admins", "state": "disabled", "adminMfa": false, "blockLegacyAuth": false }, { "displayName": "CA002 - Block legacy authentication", "state": "disabled", "adminMfa": false, "blockLegacyAuth": false } ] } }

controls.title: Enable Conditional Access policies to block legacy authentication
controls.description: A Conditional Access policy must block legacy authentication clients tenant-wide.
controls.rationale: Legacy protocols cannot present an MFA challenge, so they are the preferred path for password spraying.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Clients that cannot use modern authentication will stop connecting.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AA-03 Users and devices are authenticated
controls.auditProcedure:
GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies
Confirm an enabled policy blocks the exchangeActiveSync and other legacy client app types.
controls.remediationProcedure: Create a Conditional Access policy named 'CA002 - Block legacy authentication' with client apps set to Exchange ActiveSync clients and Other clients, grant control Block, and set its state to enabled.

audit.name: Look for an enabled legacy authentication block

assertions.failure: No enabled Conditional Access policy blocks legacy authentication ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Create and enable a Conditional Access policy that blocks Exchange ActiveSync and other legacy clients.

remediation.name: Deploy the legacy authentication block policy
remediation.payload: { "method": "PATCH", "path": "/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies", "emulatorKey": "graph:conditionalAccessPolicies", "body": { "value": [ { "displayName": "CA001 - Require MFA for admins", "state": "enabled", "adminMfa": true, "blockLegacyAuth": false }, { "displayName": "CA002 - Block legacy authentication", "state": "enabled", "adminMfa": false, "blockLegacyAuth": true } ] } }

rollback.name: Disable the legacy authentication block
rollback.payload: { "method": "PATCH", "path": "/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies", "emulatorKey": "graph:conditionalAccessPolicies", "body": { "value": [ { "displayName": "CA001 - Require MFA for admins", "state": "enabled", "adminMfa": true, "blockLegacyAuth": false }, { "displayName": "CA002 - Block legacy authentication", "state": "disabled", "adminMfa": false, "blockLegacyAuth": false } ] } }

controls.title: Ensure the 'Microsoft Entra ID Protection Sign-in risk' policy is Enabled
controls.description: A risk-based Conditional Access policy must challenge or block medium and high sign-in risk.
controls.rationale: Risk-based access is what catches a valid credential being used from an impossible location or a known malicious IP.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Risky sign-ins will be challenged for MFA.
controls.auditProcedure:
GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies
Confirm a policy has signInRiskLevels of medium and high with grant control mfa.
controls.remediationProcedure: Create a sign-in risk Conditional Access policy. Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2.

audit.name: Look for a sign-in risk policy

assertions.failure: No sign-in risk Conditional Access policy is enabled ({actual}).
assertions.hint: Licence Microsoft Entra ID P2, then enable the sign-in risk policy for medium and high risk.

controls.title: Ensure custom banned passwords lists are used
controls.description: The tenant must maintain a custom banned password list on top of the Microsoft global list.
controls.rationale: Organisation-specific terms - brand names, local sports teams, office locations - are the first thing an attacker tries.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will be prevented from choosing passwords containing banned terms.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AA-01 Identities and credentials are managed
controls.auditProcedure: Navigate to Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Password protection and confirm 'Enforce custom list' is set to Yes with entries present.
controls.remediationProcedure: Set Enforce custom list to Yes and add organisation-specific banned terms.

assertions.failure: The custom banned password list is {actual}, so only Microsoft's global list is enforced.
assertions.hint: Enable the custom banned password list and populate it with organisation-specific terms.

assertions.failure: The custom banned password list is empty ({count} entries).
assertions.hint: Add organisation-specific banned terms such as the company name, product names and local landmarks.

remediation.name: Enable and populate the custom banned password list

rollback.name: Restore the previous password protection settings

controls.title: Ensure 'Privileged Identity Management' is used to manage roles
controls.description: Privileged directory roles must be assigned as eligible through PIM rather than permanently active.
controls.rationale: Standing privilege means a single credential compromise is immediately a tenant compromise.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Administrators will need to activate their role before performing privileged work.
controls.auditProcedure:
GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleEligibilitySchedules
Confirm privileged roles are assigned as eligible rather than active.
controls.remediationProcedure: Convert active privileged role assignments to eligible assignments in Privileged Identity Management. Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2.

assertions.failure: No privileged roles are managed through PIM ({count} eligible assignments found); every admin role is permanently active.
assertions.hint: Licence Microsoft Entra ID P2 and convert standing admin assignments into PIM-eligible assignments with approval and justification.
